system.description:
Grants the ability to deal damage through offensive means.

  • Level -1: The attack doesn’t inflict regular damage
  • Level 0: The Weapon’s Base Damage is 0 and thus the final damage is only equal to the character’s Attack Combat Value
  • Level 1: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 1 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
  • Level 2: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 2 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
  • Level 3: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 3 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
  • Level 4: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 4 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
  • Level 5: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 5 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
  • Level 6: The Weapon’s Base Damage is equal to 6 times the character’s Damage Multiplier
